args.summary: checkout-api deployed to v2.3.1 began failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. Verification confirmed the service was unhealthy on v2.3.1 (note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging). Mitigation performed: rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback complete; post-rollback health check confirms the service is healthy with error rate back to 0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 and failing health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Reviewing release history, the most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all three production regions. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy again with the error rate down to 0.2%.

3. **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api documenting the unhealthy state, the rollback to v2.3.0, and verification of restored health. The on-call engineer has been paged.
